fusions.name: Pocketed Pebble
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage.

fusions.name: Swinging Heel
fusions.desc: Spins off a rope and kicks out, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Sticky Fingers
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
